this_title: 陪你走到世界末日的盡頭
trans_title: 陪你走到世界末日的尽头
introduction: 2012年冬日，在世界末日傳說降臨當晚，一對情侶漫步澳門的橫街窄巷，憶起相戀多年的點滴，最終實現對彼此的承諾。In the winter of 2012, on the night when the legend of the end of the world came, a couple walked through the narrow streets of Macau, reminiscing about their years of love, and finally fulfilled their promise to each other.
chinese_title: 陪你走到世界末日的尽头
foreign_title: 陪你走到世界末日的盡頭
